name: solid-fea
description: 3D structure of printed parts: a SIMP topology optimiser that proposes where material goes, and a CalculiX wrapper (gmsh tets, fTetWild where gmsh fails, mesh quality checks, an equilibrium check independent of the solver) that evaluators use on the printed shape.
lenses: the load case nobody wrote down
where the optimiser's grid is coarser than the part
what the field says against what was printed
the joint: fillet, or stress concentrator
mesh dependence of a peak stress
the solve that does not balance its loads
the run that stopped, not converged
origin: built by the extension protocol in the PETGasus drone project (2026-10-17), after a flat 2.5D plate frame was reviewed as 'a 2D design' on r/diydrones

provides_proposers.description: 3D SIMP topology optimisation of a voxel problem the model writes: density filter, projection, OC; direct solves (PARDISO or SuperLU) where memory allows, AMG-CG beyond; proposes a density field
scans build directions of a part: surface needing support, and how much of the worst crash stress acts across the layers
